units: 100 times log of FX-per-EUR rate ratio; positive denotes log loss for foreign currency in EUR valuation; not executable P&L
endpoint_rule: decision and target endpoint must both lie in the same declared period
selection: lowest development mean upper-loss FZ0 per currency/horizon among five weights; ordered-grid tie rule; no test refitting or new hyperparameters
variance_update: q_t=lambda*q_(t-1)+(1-lambda)*L_(t-1,t)^2; lambda=2^(-1/halflife); q_60=mean first60 squared one-interval losses
historical_scenarios: h-interval log losses ending j in t-window+1..t, all endpoint<=t; standardized by sqrt(h*q_(j-h)); multiply by sqrt(h*q_t)
tail_formula: q=sorted[ceil(alpha*N)-1]; ES=q+mean(max(scenario-q,0))/(1-alpha), including fractional boundary mass
score: S(q,e,y)=log(e)+(q+max(y-q,0)/(1-alpha))/e-1; requires e>0 and q<=e; invalid forecasts raise, no clamping
uncertainty: descriptive paired held-out summaries; no iid confidence intervals or population significance claims
arithmetic: binary64 forecast study; no interval/arithmetic certificate for logarithms or volatility estimates
data_vintage: latest revised download, no historical release vintages; chronological prefix evaluation conditional on this snapshot; not an as-was-known real-time backtest
causality_checks: future perturbation and suffix truncation must leave forecasts and state unchanged; period-crossing target labels excluded from selection/evaluation
